name: acp-client
description: Agent Client Protocol client for VS Code — connect to GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Kiro CLI, Hermes Agent, and any ACP-compatible AI coding agent

viewsWelcome.contents:
No agents configured.
[Add Agent](command:acp.addAgent)
Configure agents in settings or browse the [Agent Registry](command:acp.browseRegistry).

view/item/context.when: view == acp-sessions && (viewItem =~ /^session/ || viewItem == local-no-delete || viewItem == session-local-no-delete)

acp.agents.description: Agent configurations. Each key is the agent name, value has command, args, and env. Cursor defaults to cursor-agent acp (on PATH); falls back to cursor-acp if cursor-agent is missing.

acp.autoApprovePermissions.description: Automatically approve agent permission requests. 'ask' always prompts, 'allowAll' approves everything, 'remember' auto-approves commands and tools you have approved before (persisted across sessions).

acp.approvedCommands.description: List of normalized commands that have been approved by the user and will be auto-approved in 'remember' mode.

acp.approvedTools.description: Fingerprints of non-command tools (e.g. Kiro subagent crew) approved via allow_always / remember. Survives VS Code reload.

acp.deniedCommands.description: List of command prefixes that are always denied (auto-rejected). Merged with built-in denylist (rm -rf, sudo, etc.).

acp.defaultWorkingDirectory.description: Default working directory for agent sessions. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.

acp.debug.description: Master debug switch. When enabled, verbose diagnostics such as [FORK-DEBUG] (fork-to-agent memory/skill injection) are logged to the ACP Client output channel.

acp.debugResume.description: Log session resume/load diagnostics ([WV-DIAG], [WV-MERGE], user_message_chunk turn boundaries) to the ACP Client output channel and ~/.acp-debug/resume-diag.jsonl. Enable when debugging collapsed-block splits after reload. Enabled if set true in any settings scope, so a value left over in Remote/Machine settings cannot silence it.

acp.debugWebviewQueue.description: Log composer queue diagnostics ([WV-QUEUE] per submission, [WV-QUEUEVIS] per render) to the ACP Client output channel and ~/.acp-debug/webview-faults.log. Enable when a message typed during a streaming turn does not appear as a queue chip. Enabled if set true in any settings scope. Uncaught webview errors ([WV-ERROR]) are always logged and are not affected by this setting.

acp.debugRender.description: Log markdown-render decisions ([WV-MDRENDER]) to the ACP Client channel and ~/.acp-debug/webview-faults.log. Names the exact branch that left an assistant bubble without the md-rendered class — which makes it show raw markdown with literal **bold** and every blank line preserved.

acp.compaction.hookWatcher.description: Watch ~/.cursor/acp-debug/compaction-events.jsonl (from the preCompact hook) and reset memory-inject gates when Cursor auto-compacts. Install the hook with scripts/install-precompact-hook.ps1 or .sh.

acp.autoSteerQueuedMessages.description: Deliver a message typed mid-turn into the RUNNING turn instead of waiting for it to end, so it is picked up at the agent's next step (after a tool call or a reply segment). One message is in flight at a time: the next is released only once the agent confirms it has put the previous one in front of the model. Turn this off to make every mid-turn message wait for the next turn instead. Not part of ACP — it uses the session/steer extension, so it only applies to agents that implement it (Claude Code, Codex).

acp.logTraffic.description: Log all ACP protocol traffic to the output channel.

acp.logTrafficMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the ACP Traffic output channel before it is cleared. Prevents unbounded memory growth in long sessions.

acp.voice.enabled.description: Enable the microphone (dictation) button in the chat composer. Recording runs in the extension host; audio is transcribed by a local OpenAI-compatible STT server.

acp.voice.stt.endpoint.description: Transcription endpoint. whisper.cpp whisper-server serves POST /inference (default port 8080); OpenAI-compatible servers (FunASR FastAPI wrappers, vLLM/Qwen3-ASR) use /v1/audio/transcriptions. Both return {"text": ...}.

acp.voice.stt.model.description: Model name sent in the transcription form body. whisper.cpp ignores it; FunASR/Qwen3-ASR wrappers use it to select the model.

acp.voice.stt.apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for the STT endpoint.

acp.voice.stt.language.description: ISO language code sent to the STT server (e.g. en, zh). Empty = auto-detect — required for mixed English+Chinese dictation.

acp.voice.stt.prompt.default: 以下是编程助手的语音口述，中文部分一律使用简体中文，夹杂英文技术术语。Coding assistant dictation mixing English and Simplified Chinese. Terms: VS Code, ACP, Agent Client Protocol, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, LLM, vLLM, Transformer, attention, KV cache, API, JSON, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Whisper, Qwen, CUDA, GPU.
acp.voice.stt.prompt.description: Contextual-biasing prompt forwarded to the STT server (whisper.cpp initial prompt). Naming tech terms here measurably improves their recognition.

acp.voice.recordCommand.description: Recorder command template overriding the platform default (macOS/Windows: SoX `rec`; Linux: `arecord`). Must contain {file}, e.g. `ffmpeg -y -f avfoundation -i :0 -ar 16000 -ac 1 {file}`. The process is stopped with SIGINT and must finalize a 16 kHz mono WAV.

acp.voice.captureMode.description: Where the microphone is captured. 'auto' uses the local companion extension in remote windows (Remote SSH / WSL / Dev Containers) when installed, and the extension host otherwise. 'localCompanion' always requires the companion (hard error if missing). 'extensionHost' always records in this process (the old behaviour — right for a machine with a real mic).

acp.voice.windowsRecorder.description: Which capture backend the companion uses on Windows. 'auto' uses the built-in MCI recorder when no SoX binary is on the client's PATH, SoX when there is. 'mci' always the built-in Windows recorder (nothing to install). 'binary' always SoX/ffmpeg; errors with an install hint when missing.

acp.voice.maxDurationSec.description: Maximum recording length in seconds before auto-stop and transcription.

acp.voice.silenceAutoStopSec.description: Auto-stop recording after this many seconds of silence and transcribe immediately (SoX rec only; speech must be detected first, so it never stops before you start talking). 0 = off, manual stop only. Background audio (videos, music) above the mic threshold delays auto-stop.

acp.voice.silenceThresholdPct.description: Silence gate threshold as percent of full scale (SoX rec only). Lower it for quiet mics (e.g. Bluetooth headsets in HFP mode) if speech gets cut off; raise it if background noise delays auto-stop.

acp.voice.autoSend.description: Send the message immediately after the voice transcript is inserted into the composer. Off = transcript is inserted for review first.

acp.voice.corrections.description: Deterministic correction dictionary applied to the transcript before insertion (Voice Memory phase 1). Keys are misrecognitions, values the fixes, e.g. {"机翼": "记忆", "SAP": "ACP"}. ASCII keys match on word boundaries; CJK keys use plain replace.

acp.voice.corrector.enabled.description: Run the transcript through a restraint-biased LLM corrector that reads the voice memory file and decides per take to fix or abstain (Voice Memory phase 2, arXiv:2607.26410). Fails open to the raw transcript.

acp.voice.corrector.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL for the corrector/optimizer model (Ollama by default; vllm-proxy/llama-server also work).

acp.voice.corrector.model.description: Model name for the corrector/optimizer chat endpoint.

acp.voice.corrector.apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for the corrector endpoint.

acp.voice.corrector.timeoutMs.description: Corrector request timeout. On timeout the raw transcript is used.

acp.voice.memoryFile.description: Path to the voice memory rules file read by the corrector and revised by the ACP: Review Voice Memory command. Empty = ~/.vscode-acp/voice-memory.md (feedback log lives alongside it as voice-feedback.jsonl).

acp.sessionSummary.endpoint.description: responses-vllm-proxy base URL for /session summarization (POST /v1/summarize-session). Matches Pi vllm-proxy provider baseUrl without /v1.

acp.sessionSummary.apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for the vLLM proxy when api-keys are enabled.

acp.sessionSummary.model.description: Model alias (resolved by the proxy) used for /session summarization. Set empty to use the proxy's auto-selection (largest context).

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used as fallback when the primary summarize endpoint fails (proxy down, timeout, non-OK response). Recommended: https://api.deepseek.com (official DeepSeek API, POST /v1/chat/completions — verified via api-docs.deepseek.com). Empty = fallback disabled.

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackApiKey.description: Bearer token for the fallback endpoint (a DeepSeek API key from platform.deepseek.com). Empty = fallback disabled.

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackModel.description: Model id used by the fallback endpoint (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, 1M-token context).

acp.memory.enabled.description: Enable TencentDB Agent Memory (Model B): shared team memory with per-agent profiles (codex/claude/kiro/…). Requires a running MemoryCore Gateway.

acp.memory.endpoint.description: MemoryCore Gateway base URL (no trailing slash).

acp.memory.serviceId.description: Memory instance / space id (x-tdai-service-id). Shared by all ACP agents.

acp.memory.teamId.description: Team id for Model B isolation. Shared by all ACP agents so team-visible Skills/Knowledge can be shared.

acp.memory.userId.description: User id for memory isolation (shared across Windows/Mac). Use one canonical id (e.g. zaedinzeng). Empty defaults to zaedinzeng — not the OS username.

acp.memory.agentIdMap.description: Optional map of ACP agent config name → MemoryCore agent_id. Unmapped names use built-in heuristics (Codex→codex, Claude→claude, Kiro→kiro, …).

acp.memory.recallMaxResults.description: Max L1 atomic memories to inject on each prompt.

acp.memory.minScore.description: Minimum relevance score for L1 memory injection. Memories below this threshold are excluded. 0 = no filtering (all memories injected).

acp.memory.includePersona.description: Include L3 persona (core) for the agent profile on recall.

acp.memory.includeSceneNav.description: Include L2 scenario navigation index for the agent profile on recall.

acp.memory.includeSkills.description: Include extracted skills (names + descriptions) in the recall blob on every prompt.

acp.memory.skillCharBudget.description: Maximum character budget for the skills section in the recall blob.

acp.memory.captureEnabled.description: Write L0 conversation turns to MemoryCore after each prompt completes.

acp.memory.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for MemoryCore Gateway requests (milliseconds).

acp.memory.recallRetryCount.description: Retries per gateway request after transient network errors (fetch failed, connection refused). 0 disables retries.

acp.memory.recallRetryDelayMs.description: Delay between memory gateway retry attempts (milliseconds).

acp.memory.debug.description: Verbose timing/debug logging for memory recall + injection (per-call latency, total recall time, injection-vs-prompt-send timing). Written to the 'ACP Client' output channel.
